findings.title: Freeze a Windows cross-interface identity contract before replacing full tuple equality
findings.body: Observed pathname and fd pins differ in mode and ctime only. CPython3.12.10 pathname stat synthesizes executable mode bits and substitutes creation time into ctime; fd fstat retains attributes-derived mode and ChangeTime. Equality compares different field meanings. This is a qualification observer contract issue, not demonstrated product/runtime or mutation defect; correction must retain exact native identity, both time meanings and attributes/mode-view checks, without dropping fields or tolerance.

diagnosis.established: Actual captured mismatch has exactly mode and ctime; allfive other full pin values equal. Primary3.12.10 source explains distinct conversion semantics: pathname win32_xstat applies filename mode overlay and copies birthtime into ctime; _Py_fstat_noraise invokes attribute conversion that uses ChangeTime for ctime and no suffix overlay.

proposed_source_contract: Separate pinned Windows function obtains borrowed OS handle from exactly retained os.open fd; never closes borrowed HANDLE independently and never reopens a guessed pathname. Freeze ABI/access/right/argument/count/error/cleanup bounds before any call.

Read-only GetFileInformationByHandleEx FileBasicInfo + FileStandardInfo + FileIdInfo (and reparse/tag information if required) on the same handle; require non-directory/nonreparse regular disk file, full volume+128bitID, exact nlink/size, raw attributes, CreationTime/LastWriteTime/ChangeTime, with exact 100ns-to-ns conversion and no tolerance/fallback truncation.

Validate fdstat mode equals attributes-derived regular/read-only mode; validate pathname mode equals that same base plus exactly the pinned recognized suffix overlay. Preserve exact separate pathname and fd views and same-view before/after equality, not universal masking0111. These synthetic POSIX modes do not establish effective ACL permissions; any DACL/access claim needs separately specified read-only native evidence.

Validate pathname ctime exactly against converted native CreationTime; fd ctime exactly against native ChangeTime; validate mtime against LastWriteTime and retain both original fulltimes. No droppingctime or arbitrary delta allowance.

Retain exact dev/ino/nlink/size, native raw identity+times/attributes before/after read, existing path/ancestor/reparse/original-path checks and explicit fd close. Fail on native missing data/identity/view mismatch/drift; frozen new source must be independently reviewed before corrective invocation.
